newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan marchers condemn Russia, Iran, India.
newsitem.headline: Afghan marchers condemn Russia, Iran, India.

text.p: Thousands of Afghans marched through the southern city of Kandahar on Saturday to protest against alleged interference by Russia, Iran and India in their country's affairs, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service said.
About 35,000 people took part in the demonstration in support of the new Taleban Islamic government in Kabul, the Afghan Islamic Press (AIP) quoted its sources in the city as saying.
The marchers delivered a statement to the U.N. office in Kandahar accusing Russia, Iran and India of assisting the forces of ousted president Burhanuddin Rabbani.
It urged the United Nations to end such alleged interference and called for the recognition of the Taleban government and respect for its Islamic programmes.
In Kabul, acting deputy foreign minister Sher Mohammad Stanakzai met a British diplomat and called on Britain to recognise the Taleban government, official Kabul Radio said.
